subject.title: refactor(protocol): pre-publish cheat-window cleanup and vintage tracking

question: Should this PR accept a hard compatibility break for the claimed beta-only `question.*` and session-catalog protocol families before public npm publication?
rationale: The source policy treats incompatible gateway protocol changes as an owner decision, while the PR's unshipped-surface audit cannot by itself prove that no external beta consumer relies on the retired shapes.

options.title: Accept the beta-only break after completion
options.body: Approve the clean protocol reshape once the stale QA scenario is migrated and redacted live request/resolve evidence confirms the new wire contract.

options.title: Preserve the old wire contract temporarily
options.body: Keep an explicit compatibility path until a release-boundary or consumer migration plan is approved, accepting additional temporary surface area.

options.title: Split publication metadata from reshaping
options.body: Land only the non-breaking vintage and cleanup portions, then review the wire-contract break in a narrower compatibility-focused PR.

recommendation.title: Accept the beta-only break after completion
recommendation.body: Approve the clean protocol reshape once the stale QA scenario is migrated and redacted live request/resolve evidence confirms the new wire contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Steipete is the assigned author of the proposed compatibility boundary and has authored the listed protocol and consumer updates; current-main ownership could not be independently traced here.
